scope.objective: Cross-bind accepted Rank8 Ward5 Mind Blank and Antimagic Field authored procedures to the retained Decay relay and conditional W17D profile.

sourceBindings.qualification: Conditional source-qualified access only; no campaign actor or cast is established.

sourceMatrix.finding: The retained Decay branch models each relay as an individually targeted, single-order mental-compulsion relation linked to A:cast1 and A:cast1:body1. Avatar body/source/aura and ordinary attack/damage are separate components. The Decay local rule cancels only the affected relay when rider-only suppression applies, preserving the parent and unaffected relations.

The accepted static Abjuration procedure is Action, V/S/F, rank 8, base 21 RP, 120 ft, one willing perceived creature, no save, no concentration, and 3,600 elapsed seconds. It suppresses an existing covered mental-compulsion expression; applying Decay's relation-ending rule then cancels that relay rather than generically curing or reviving it.

A real qualified caster and legal runtime spell selection
Current resources, casting cadence, concentration transition, and response window
An integrated paid encounter proving the interaction with the existing relay and retained guard/cost history

sourceMatrix.finding: The accepted static Abjuration procedure is Action, V/S/F, rank 8, base 21 RP, perceived center within 20 ft, fixed 20-ft-radius sphere, concentration, and maximum 60 elapsed seconds. Its adopted Lesser local-expression rule suppresses actual magical expressions at their manifestation body/anchor/area; a creature-attached spell expression is suppressed if any part of its body intersects the operative field. Whole-body Avatar overlap fails the required body/aura preservation condition, but the procedure does not establish that every spatial arrangement fails.
remainingInputs: Exact manifestation locus of the existing relay
An encounter-bound center and geometry that covers the relay expression while preserving the Avatar body/aura and unaffected relations
A real qualified caster, paid activation, current resources/cadence/concentration, and response window
Integrated evidence of field and relay clocks, cancellation, reservations/guards, and no revival/refill

sourceMatrix.finding: W17D is a conditional Wizard 17 Divination profile with both Mind Blank and Antimagic Field in its level-15 spellbook additions and prepared list. campaignExistenceVerified=false, so this is not an actual campaign actor, resource state, or paid activation. Both spells remain runtime-disabled despite their accepted static authored procedures.

SH333-RIDER-CANCEL cancels F/relay:3 at tick 300, preserves A:cast1 through tick 6020, Avatar HP/aura, relay:1 and relay:2, and the relay:3 original expiry at tick 510. It demonstrates component cancellation only: no provider activation, paid cost, or elapsed provider/relay clock integration.

preciseGap: The static Ward5 authored rules provide relevant suppression operations; the record does not show a paid runtime use against an existing Decay relay. Mind Blank requires an actually willing target. Antimagic Field requires the relay's manifestation locus and compatible encounter geometry. Neither provider has a complete integrated paid witness covering legal actor/access, costs/resources/cadence, response windows, clocks, cancellation, reservation/guard disposition, and no revival/refill.
